starter_files.purpose: Semantic HTML shell, local stylesheet, jQuery 4.0.0 script, and a named workspace.
Responsive starter styles, visible focus, and reduced-motion baseline.
jQuery-ready initialization with TODO steps and a visible status region.

stretch_features: Add a focused automated test for the main interaction.
Document the API/runtime assumptions and a failure case.
Profile or audit one relevant accessibility, security, or performance concern.
tests_and_acceptance: All required features can be demonstrated from a fresh page load.
Empty and error states are clear rather than silently failing.
Keyboard users can reach and operate all essential controls.
User/API text is rendered safely; server state and totals are not trusted to the client.
The test matrix records viewport, browser, expected result, actual result, and known gaps.

rubric.description: Core interactions and normal/error cases work as specified.
Readable functions, appropriate selectors, and predictable state.
Semantic HTML, keyboard access, focus, labels/statuses, reduced motion, and viewport checks.
Safe rendering, explicit failure states, and server responsibilities documented.
Repeatable test evidence, setup notes, known limits, and clear project documentation.

review_method: Static review plus local browser walkthrough; automate focused DOM and asynchronous tests where applicable. Human review remains required for accessibility and product quality.
